sync_warning.title: Mismatch Detected:
sync_warning.body: @:empire.configuration.sync_warning.title {configured} configured vs. {planned} planned permits. Please synchronize these values using your in-game {hq_buffer} to ensure accurate faction bonus calculations.

plan_list.setup_prompt: Assign existing plans in {management} or use {search} to create one.

opportunities.headline: Production Opportunities
opportunities.intro: Find recipe opportunities to convert excess materials into other products. This view identifies production opportunities where your Material I/O shows a positive delta, prioritized by input availability
opportunities.note: Do not rely on the available opportunity alone. Cross-reference trade volumes and exchange overviews (via hover on the material) to assess market liquidity and potential ROI. Use indicators to identify which specific material is bottlenecking your scaling potential or if selling your available delta is more profitable than moving to another production.

onboarding.title: Welcome to PRUNplanner
onboarding.intro: Three steps to your first base plan.

empire.title: Your empire
empire.help: Faction and permits affect your plans' faction bonus and available area.

plan.title: Plan your first base
plan.help: Find a planet and create a plan there. It's added to this empire automatically.

prices.title: Prices
prices.help: Prices use the universe 30-day average. Change which exchange each material is bought and sold on in {exchanges}.

empty.title: No empires yet
empty.text: An empire groups your base plans and holds your faction and permits.
